cases.notes: Routing must still fire when the project already contains generated_by: ult-autoscaffold-content drafts. This skill is the enforcement point for the fail-closed rule implemented in scripts/draft_coverage.py and documented in SKILL.md Steps 5/5.5/6: a skeleton or uncited autoscaffold draft is no coverage, a cited-but-unreviewed draft is draft_coverage/INFERRED and cannot clear a Step 7/D8 gap or corroborate What-L3 in Step 6, and cep:ext external-suggestion blocks are excluded unless include_external_suggestions is set — this case exists so a future change to the trigger phrasing doesn't quietly stop routing autoscaffolded projects through the real fail-closed pipeline.
